title: aeluropus pubescens
intro: Aeluropus pubescens, commonly known as Sea Fennel, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Aeluropus pubescens include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce stress, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Overall, Sea Fennel has been used in traditional medicine for its potential to promote relaxation and improve overall well-being.
